title: Store Update 1.46.0
body:
# Store Update 1.46.0

Raiders!

Store Update 1.46.0 is now live, adding two new colour variants for the Boonie Set: Black and Green Camo. If you already own the outfit, these variants unlock automatically. No restart needed!

# Ascending the Mountain

Ferrovian engineers are still hard at work on Apollo's ongoing experimental transportation project, aided by the vital supplies Raiders have contributed.

Meanwhile, Lance is raking in profits from medical supply sales, thanks to all the... misfires.

Keep watching for updates. We might be closer than you think to a first glimpse of the frigid peaks!

# Trials Season 5: One Last Push

This is the final week of Trials Season 5. You have until September 22 to climb the ranks, so now is the time to gather your crew, dust off your gear, and make one last push toward earning the Scorta Set.

For this closing week, the Trials will pit you against some of the deadliest threats found Topside: Queens and Matriarchs. They are tough, dangerous, and not inclined to give up points easily.

See you Topside,
//Ossen
